reading: The sketch lays out an admin 'Users' management page: a left dark-navy nav sidebar, a page header with Export/Invite buttons, a filter toolbar, a bulk-selection action bar, a large user data table, and a pager at the bottom. Typed notes give exact colors, spacing, and copy for every part.
